title: Person: Mr Dedalus
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Dedalus

anchor.prefix:
et the matter drop now.

 Dante turned on her and said:

 —And am I to sit here and listen to the pastors of my church being flouted?

 —Nobody is saying a word against them, said
anchor.suffix:
, so long as they don’t meddle in politics.

 —The bishops and priests of Ireland have spoken, said Dante, and they must be obeyed.

 —Let them leave politics alone, said Mr Casey,
